reviews.title: Lovely green tower!
reviews.comment: It's a very nice tower, not to big nor small. I only wish the interior was white but other than that I love it!!!
reviews.author: AlexandriaS

reviews.title: Good case
reviews.comment: Good case but pretty small inside. I have big hands so was tight.
reviews.author: Whirlpool

reviews.title: Amazing Case! Looks even better in person.
reviews.comment: Great case, looks phenomenal and has plenty of room for cable management and different styles coolers. The glass panels are very easy to remove for maintenance and cleaning. The paint is good quality, and I couldn't be happier with my purchase decision.
reviews.author: SomeGuy

reviews.title: Great bang for buck case!
reviews.comment: This case is wonderful! The matcha green color is vibrant and well finished. The extra $10 for the three included fans is a life--and money--saver! Your computer will look wonderful with the large pieces of tempered glass! The only thing I would change is making the brackets for the GPU slot removable instead of breakaways; however, this is a great case overall!
reviews.author: ElijahT

reviews.title: Great stater case
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] Love that it comes with the fans. Its a good size caze but needs a little extra care when doing cable management as there isn’t much space on the side but it’s definitely do able and a fantastic color.
reviews.author: Allie
